note: The page's own reading of which outcomes each leaf still faces, and line 6 per leaf. Editorial: decision 5. regulatory.json is never edited by the game; it is a first draft made with an AI's help (Sep 2026) and not yet reviewed, so every sentence here that leans on it is hedged. Line 6 asks one question for every leaf, 'is a lever known to work where this lands?', and today reads the same for every leaf: yielding (no lever is shown to work against the leaf's main danger) and turning (this reading could change). What is AIMED at each leaf's danger differs, and is said in words ('why'), never drawn as a firm line: 'aimed at' is not 'shown to work'. The race sits under every branch, so every leaf faces it. Contain and Shut down face bio-misuse and cyber too: stopping does not recall models already released, and a caged model still has users. Shut down's main open question is the race (can a stop be agreed among the main builders and held?), not 'no known mechanism': for existential risk the draft list names not building it, or slowing down enough to find out, as the only moves left, and that is this leaf's own action.
